name: BWild Grain Free Sterilised Cat Paté

variants.name: Tuna 100 g
variants.about_this_item: Monge Natural Superpremium Bwild Grain Free Tuna with vegetables is a complete and balanced food for adult cats after sterilisation . The specially developed formula, with its increased protein content, helps your cat to maintain a slim figure. The recipe is enriched with Xyloligosaccharides (XOS), a new generation of prebiotics to support intestinal health. The food contains yucca schidigera to reduce faecal odours.
variants.ingredient_information:
Composition: Tuna (26%), pork liver, chicken meat, fresh carrots (2%), dried tomato pomace, dried green beans 1% (equal to 4.3% of fresh beans), minerals, hydrolysed animal protein, pea fibre, xylo-oligosaccharide (XOS 0.1%), yucca schidigera (0.1%), spirulina.

Analytical constituents: Crude protein: 12%, Crude fibre: 1.25%, Crude fat: 3%, Crude ash: 2%, Moisture: 79%.

Additives: NUTRITIONAL ADDITIVES: Vitamin D3 294 IU/kg, Vitamin E (all-rac-alpha-tocopheryl-acetate) 10.5 mg/kg, Selenium (Sodium selenite 0.05 mg/ kg) 0.02 mg/kg, Manganese (manganous sulphate monohydrate 7.5 mg/kg) 2.4 mg/kg, Zinc (Zinc oxide 35 mg/kg): 28.1 mg/kg, Copper (Copper (II) sulphate pentahydrate 3 mg/kg) 0.76 mg/kg, Iron (Iron (II) sulphate monohydrate 25 mg/kg) 8.22 mg/kg, Iodine (Calcium iodate anhydrous 0.4 mg/kg) 0.26 mg/kg, taurine 1,000 mg/kg.
